full.title: What If Eazy-E Never Died? | Hip Hop What If
full.description:
What if Eazy-E survived 1995 and lived long enough to shape the next era of West Coast hip hop? This episode follows the documented timeline through Eazy-E's final months, then clearly branches into a fictional alternate future involving Ruthless Records, Bone Thugs-N-Harmony, a possible N.W.A reunion, and a different West Coast power map.

The real-history setup is documented: Eazy-E founded Ruthless Records and helped form N.W.A.; Bone Thugs-N-Harmony had become a major Ruthless success; and the Los Angeles Times reported on February 26, 1995 that long-rumored N.W.A reunion talks were stepping up after Eazy parted ways with Jerry Heller, with a reunion album being discussed for 1996. Eazy-E died March 26, 1995 from complications of AIDS. Everything after that historical cutoff in this episode is hypothetical alternate-history commentary.

Visual source material in this rebuild uses public-domain/CC0 photography and original local motion/compositing. No commercial music is used.
